geography: Fram Formation, southern Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada
overview: Frasnian Tiktaalik roseae is documented by NUFV 108 and other Fram Formation material from southern Ellesmere Island. Its preserved body combines scales and fin rays with a mobile neck, robust ribs and wrist-like joints within a pectoral fin. The combination informs comparisons of fins and limbs; it does not identify a direct ancestor.
overviewZh: Frasnian 期的 Tiktaalik roseae 由加拿大努纳武特埃尔斯米尔岛南部 Fram 组的 NUFV 108 等材料记录。化石显示鳞片与鳍条、可活动颈部、粗壮肋骨，以及仍带鳍条的胸鳍内腕状关节并存。这种组合有助于比较鱼鳍与四肢的演化，但不能据此认定它是后世动物的直接祖先。

ecology.diet: An aquatic predatory role is inferred from anatomy; the cited sample does not preserve specific prey.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from a shallow marginal-water setting in the Fram Formation, not a complete map of the genus’ distribution.
ecology.locomotion: The appendage is fin-propelled; load-bearing capacity and habitual movement on land are interpretations.
ecology.bodySize: A large-bodied tetrapodomorph; this profile does not assign a measured body length.
ecology.guild: A shallow-water predator is an anatomical and depositional interpretation, not observed feeding behaviour.
ecology.dietZh: 根据解剖特征推断其可能是水生捕食者；所引样本没有保存具体猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Fram 组的浅水滨岸环境，并非该属完整分布范围的地图。
ecology.locomotionZh: 该附肢用于鳍驱动运动；其承重能力及习惯性陆地移动属于解释。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 属于大型四足形类；本条未给出测量所得的体长。
ecology.guildZh: 浅水捕食者的描述是基于解剖结构和沉积环境作出的解释，并非对摄食行为的直接观察。

traits: Scales and fin rays remain on the pectoral appendage
Mobile neck and robust ribs occur in the same body
evidenceSummary: Named Fram Formation specimens and the primary descriptions support this anatomical mosaic. The sampled occurrence is not a global genus range, and neither direct ancestry nor habitual terrestrial walking is claimed.

title.en: A fin with a distinctive combination

text.zh: 具名标本既保留鳞片和鳍条，也显示腕状关节、可活动的颈部与粗壮肋骨。这些结构共同出现在一具身体上，使研究者能够比较早期四足形类的解剖组合。
text.en: The named specimens retain scales and fin rays while also preserving wrist-like joints, a mobile neck and robust ribs. These structures occur together in one body, letting researchers compare anatomical combinations across early tetrapodomorphs.

title.zh: 从保存的骨骼推测运动

text.zh: 关节或肋骨形态可以约束可能的运动方式，却不会直接记录日常行为。胸鳍是否承重、是否经常在陆地上行走，仍是解释而非直接观察。
text.en: A joint or rib constrains what movements may have been possible, but it does not record a daily action. Load-bearing use of the fin and routine walking on land remain interpretations rather than direct observations.

title.zh: 标本样本有明确的地理边界
title.en: The sample has a geographic boundary

text.zh: 这里讨论的材料来自埃尔斯米尔岛南部的 Fram 组。这组具名化石支持一个局部产出记录，但并未描绘 Tiktaalik 的完整分布范围。
text.en: The material discussed here comes from the Fram Formation on southern Ellesmere Island. That named fossil sample supports a local occurrence; it does not map the full range of Tiktaalik.

title.zh: 解剖亲缘不等于祖先关系

text.zh: 研究中的性状组合为系统发育比较提供信息，但不能证明 Tiktaalik 是后期四足动物的直接祖先。
text.en: The studied character combination informs a phylogenetic comparison. It does not make Tiktaalik a demonstrated direct ancestor of later tetrapods.

readerLimitations.en: The shallow-water setting, predatory role and possible load-bearing function are interpretations tied to the specimens and depositional context. Fossils preserve anatomy, not habitual land walking or a complete range.
readerLimitations.zh: 浅水环境、捕食者身份和可能的承重功能，都是结合标本与沉积背景作出的解释。化石保存的是解剖结构，不能直接证明经常在陆地行走，也不能给出完整分布范围。

evidenceSummaryZh: 具名的 Fram 组标本和原始描述支持这一解剖特征组合。所取样的化石记录不代表该属的全球分布范围；研究也未主张直接祖先关系或习惯性陆地行走。
traitsZh: 胸鳍附肢上仍保存鳞片和鳍条。
同一身体上兼有可活动的颈部和粗壮的肋骨。
胸鳍具有类似腕部的关节。

overview: An exceptionally complete Miguasha fossil of Elpistostege preserves a pectoral fin with both fin rays and a complex internal skeleton. Some distal bones have been interpreted as digits or digit-like elements, but the appendage remained a fin.

ecology.diet: Unavailable from the cited pectoral-fin study
ecology.habitat: Miguasha aquatic depositional setting; finer habitat preference is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Fin propulsion; load-bearing or digit-assisted use remains an inference
ecology.bodySize: Large-bodied elpistostegalian; a genus-wide size envelope is not inferred
ecology.guild: Unresolved aquatic predator or generalist; no feeding guild is assigned

traits: Four proximodistal radial rows in the pectoral fin
Branched carpals and distal elements interpreted as digits or putative digits
Lepidotrichia retained, confirming the appendage remained a fin
evidenceSummary: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 and its CT reconstruction document the fin’s internal structure. Digit homology and the animal’s position among close relatives depend on anatomical interpretation and phylogenetic analysis; this profile does not identify Elpistostege as a direct tetrapod ancestor.

text.en: An exceptionally complete Miguasha fossil of Elpistostege preserves a pectoral fin with both fin rays and a complex internal skeleton. Some distal bones have been interpreted as digits or digit-like elements, but the appendage remained a fin.
text.zh: Miguasha 一件保存极完整的 Elpistostege 化石显示，胸鳍同时保留鳍条和复杂的内部骨骼。远端一些骨骼被解释为趾或类似趾的结构，但这个附肢仍然是鳍。

text.en:
The pectoral fin of articulated specimen MHNM 06-2067 contains four rows of radial bones arranged from the proximal end toward the tip. Its carpals, or wrist bones, branch in a complex pattern, and bones nearer the fin tip have been interpreted as digits or possible digits.

Fin rays, or lepidotrichia, remain present in the appendage, confirming that this is still a fin.
text.zh:
胸鳍内部骨骼有四列沿近端至远端排列的辐状骨。

腕骨分支复杂，远端骨骼被解释为趾或可能的趾。

仍保留鳍条，即 lepidotrichia，确认该附肢仍是鳍。

title.en: A fin, its setting and movement limits
title.zh: 鳍、沉积背景与运动推断边界

text.en: Miguasha’s aquatic depositional setting frames this fossil. The fin is described as a propulsive appendage, while load-bearing or digit-assisted use remains an inference; the large-bodied description does not define a genus-wide size range.
text.zh: 化石来自 Miguasha 的水生沉积环境。胸鳍被解释为推进附肢，而承重或借助趾状结构活动仍属推断；“体型较大”的描述不代表全属体型范围。

text.en: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 and its CT reconstruction document the fin’s internal structure. Digit homology and the animal’s position among close relatives depend on anatomical interpretation and phylogenetic analysis; this profile does not identify Elpistostege as a direct tetrapod ancestor.
text.zh: 标本 MHNM 06-2067 及其 CT 重建记录了胸鳍内部结构。趾的同源判断和 Elpistostege 在近缘类群中的位置取决于解剖解释与系统发育分析；本档案不把它称为四足动物的直接祖先。

title.en: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand
title.zh: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand

scope.en: CT and anatomical analysis document an Elpistostege fin with fin rays; digit homology and placement depend on interpretation and analysis.
scope.zh: CT 与解剖分析记录 Elpistostege 胸鳍及其鳍条；趾的同源判断和系统位置取决于解释与分析。

overview: A Devonian tetrapod represented by East Greenland limb material that documents an eight-digit forelimb and preserves the distinction between digit-bearing limbs and evidence for terrestrial walking.

ecology.diet: Unavailable from the cited limb study
ecology.habitat: Aquatic or marginal-water setting inferred from the study context; preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Digit-bearing limb; terrestrial walking is not inferred from digit count alone
ecology.bodySize: Small to medium-sized early tetrapod; a study-wide mass estimate is not provided here

traits: Eight digits documented in the forelimb
Limb anatomy retains a non-pentadactyl Devonian condition
Digit-bearing limbs do not by themselves demonstrate habitual terrestrial walking
evidenceSummary: The described East Greenland limb specimens directly support eight-digit anatomy; ecological and locomotor implications remain bounded, and the profile does not infer a universal ancestral digit number or direct ancestry.

title.en: Eight digits, without a walking trace
title.zh: 八个指趾，并不等于陆地行走

text.en:
The East Greenland limb specimens described for Acanthostega preserve an eight-digit forelimb. That count differs from the five-digit pattern familiar in living tetrapods and shows that digit number varied during Devonian limb evolution. The evidence here is the anatomy of described limb material, compared with other Devonian forms.

A hand with eight digits does not record how often the animal moved on land. The cited study does not directly establish diet, habitat preference or observed gait, so the profile keeps those ecological questions open rather than converting limb anatomy into a lifestyle claim.
text.zh:
Acanthostega 在东格陵兰出土的已描述肢体材料保存了一只八指前肢。这个数量不同于现生四足动物常见的五指模式，显示泥盆纪肢体演化期间指趾数并不固定。这里的证据是所描述肢体的解剖结构及其与其他泥盆纪类群的比较。

八指的手并没有记录这种动物多常在陆地上活动。所引研究没有直接确定食性、生境偏好或实际步态，因此本档案保留这些生态问题，不把肢体结构直接转换成生活方式结论。

title.zh: Polydactyly in the earliest known tetrapod limbs

overview: Ichthyostega is a Devonian tetrapod whose reconstructed limb joints let researchers test how much rotation the limbs could achieve. One study compared that model with the mechanics of a typical lateral-sequence walk; the result concerns possible joint motion, not observed behavior.
overviewZh: 泥盆纪四足动物 Ichthyostega 的肢体关节经三维重建后，研究者可以测试肢体可能达到的转动范围，并与典型侧序步态的力学要求比较。结果说明的是重建骨骼在模型中允许怎样的关节运动，不是化石直接记录了动物如何行走。

ecology.diet: The cited joint-mobility study does not establish diet.
ecology.habitat: East Greenland fossils come from an aquatic or marginal-water setting. The animal’s preferred habitat remains uncertain.
ecology.locomotion: In the tested reconstruction, the limbs have restricted long-axis rotation. This is a model result, not a direct record of walking.
ecology.bodySize: Ichthyostega was a large-bodied early tetrapod; the cited study does not establish a broader body-size range.
ecology.guild: Its ecological role is unresolved by this locomotion study.
ecology.dietZh: 所引关节活动度研究不能确定食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 在所测试的重建模型中，肢体沿长轴旋转的幅度受限。这是模型结果，并非直接记录的行走行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Ichthyostega 是一种体型较大的早期四足动物；所引研究没有确定更广泛的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 这项运动研究未能确定其生态角色。

traits: A typical lateral-sequence walk in the tested model required no long-axis limb rotation
The mobility result may be specific to Ichthyostega, not all early tetrapods
evidenceSummary: Micro-CT reconstruction and comparison with five living analogues constrain which joint movements are mechanically feasible. The result depends on the reconstruction and does not turn feasible motion into observed behavior.
evidenceSummaryZh: 微型 CT 关节重建与五种现生类比动物的比较，限制了哪些关节运动在力学上可行。结果取决于骨骼重建和比较方式；可行运动不等于实际行为记录。

title.en: How far can a joint model take us?
title.zh: 关节模型能将推断推进到什么程度？

text.en: Ichthyostega is a Devonian tetrapod whose reconstructed limb joints let researchers test how much rotation the limbs could achieve. One study compared that model with the mechanics of a typical lateral-sequence walk; the result concerns possible joint motion, not observed behavior.
text.zh: 泥盆纪四足动物 Ichthyostega 的肢体关节经三维重建后，研究者可以测试肢体可能达到的转动范围，并与典型侧序步态的力学要求比较。结果说明的是重建骨骼在模型中允许怎样的关节运动，不是化石直接记录了动物如何行走。

title.en: A feasible gait is not an observed gait
title.zh: 模型可行的步态不等于观察到的步态

text.en: Micro-CT joint reconstructions were compared with five living analogues. In the tested model, a typical lateral-sequence walk required no long-axis limb rotation; that result describes what the reconstruction permits, not how the fossil animal was seen to walk.
text.zh: 研究将微型 CT 重建的关节与五种现生类比动物进行比较。在所测试的模型中，典型的侧序步行无需肢体沿长轴旋转；这说明重建模型允许这种运动，并非观察到化石动物实际如此行走。

title.en: The model is tied to East Greenland material
title.zh: 模型依据东格陵兰材料

text.en: The analysed Ichthyostega specimens come from Famennian Upper Devonian deposits of East Greenland. This is the study's sample context, not a complete geographic or habitat range.
text.zh: 分析的 Ichthyostega 标本来自东格陵兰法门期晚泥盆世沉积层。这是该研究的取样背景，不代表完整地理分布或栖息地范围。

title.en: Three-dimensional limb joint mobility in the early tetrapod Ichthyostega
title.zh: Three-dimensional limb joint mobility in the early tetrapod Ichthyostega

scope.en: Pierce et al. (2012), pp. 523?526, Figures 1?3 and Supplementary Figures 1?6: East Greenland specimen context, micro-CT joint reconstruction, five living analogues and modeled gait results.

readerLimitations.en: The specimens come from Famennian East Greenland deposits described as aquatic or marginal-water; that setting does not establish preferred habitat. Ichthyostega is a large-bodied early tetrapod, but this study does not establish a broader body-size range, diet, observed locomotion or a general rule for all early tetrapods. Its modeled motion result may be specific to Ichthyostega.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些标本来自东格陵兰法门期沉积层，相关环境被描述为水生或近水环境；这一背景不能证明其偏好的栖息地。Ichthyostega 是体型较大的早期四足动物，但本研究没有确定更广泛的体型范围、食性、直接观察到的运动方式，也没有提出适用于所有早期四足动物的一般规则。模型中的运动结果可能仅适用于 Ichthyostega。

traitsZh: 在所测试的模型中，典型的侧序步态无需肢体绕身体长轴旋转。
这一运动能力结果可能仅适用于 Ichthyostega，而非所有早期四足动物。
